title: What is an integer?
explanation: An integer is a whole number. It can be positive like 5 or negative like -5. Zero is also an integer.

title: Positive and negative numbers
explanation: Positive numbers are greater than zero. Negative numbers are less than zero.

title: Number line rule
explanation: Numbers to the right on the number line are bigger. Numbers to the left are smaller.
